name: SHCHAN
recent: SHCHAN 近期主要发布月度生产数据和季度生产披露，没有其他重大企业活动。一名非执行董事在公开市场增持了少量股份。
notable: 非执行董事 Thomas Tuan Kit Kwong 于 2026 年 8 月 26 日以每股 RM0.225 增持 155,000 股普通股。

ann.title: Changes in Director's Interest (Section 219 of CA 2016) - MR THOMAS TUAN KIT KWONG
DEALINGS IN LISTED SECURITIES (CHAPTER 14 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : Dealings Outside Closed Period

recent_en: SHCHAN recently released monthly production figures and a quarterly production disclosure, with no other major corporate activities. A Non-Executive Director acquired a small number of shares in the open market.
notable_en: Non-Executive Director Thomas Tuan Kit Kwong acquired 155,000 ordinary shares at RM0.225 per share on 26 August 2026.
